articles.title: Kim Jong Un vows expanded missile development ahead of party congress
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has signaled his nation's continued commitment to missile development for the next five years. This declaration occurred during his visits to major munitions enterprises in the last quarter of 2025. The move highlights North Korea's persistent efforts to bolster its military strength, potentially impacting regional security dynamics and global non-proliferation efforts, a key concern for international relations.

articles.title: Stock Market Highlights 26 December 2025: Markets slide for third straight session as foreign fund outflows drag Sensex 367 points, Nifty slips 99.80 points to 26,042.30
articles.summary: On December 26, 2025, the Indian Rupee depreciated by 15 paise, closing at 89.86 against the US dollar. This movement is a significant national economic indicator, reflecting market dynamics and potentially impacting India's trade balance and import costs. SSB aspirants should stay informed about such economic trends as they highlight the nation's financial health and global market position.

articles.title: 2025 sees highest British defence exports since records began in huge boost to workers and companies
articles.summary: The UK is set to achieve over £20 billion in defence exports to allies in 2025, marking its highest figure in over 40 years. This significant milestone includes the UK's largest-ever warship export agreement, underscoring a robust performance by its defence industry. These exports enhance global security partnerships and strengthen strategic alliances, boosting the UK's international standing and economic ties.

articles.title: Deficiencies: Time to ‘spin off’ the U.S. Navy
articles.summary: On August 12, 2019, US Navy vessels, including the USS Boxer, USNS Tippecanoe, and USS John P. Murtha, transited the highly strategic Strait of Hormuz. This routine yet significant movement underscored the continued American naval presence in the critical international waterway, a vital choke point for global oil shipments. Such transits highlight ongoing defence operations and geopolitical interests in the region, ensuring maritime security.

articles.title: T.R. Sullivan: A Retrospective On The Frank Robinson-Milt Pappas Trade
articles.summary: T.R. Sullivan, a legendary sports journalist, retired in December 2020 after a distinguished 32-year career covering the Rangers baseball beat. He wrote for prominent publications like the Denison Herald, Fort Worth Star-Telegram, and MLB.com, establishing himself as a highly respected figure in sports journalism.
